parts.name: arm strip 0

physics.Basic_description: A long, flat strip of light-colored wood with a smooth finish, forming the stationary lower arm of the tongs.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid base against which the moving arm presses to grip objects.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper can grasp the mid-section or handle end of this wooden strip to stabilize the tool.
physics.reason: The part is a thin slat of wood where the thickness is comparable to the cross-section dimensions, making it effectively solid material rather than a hollow shell.

parts.description: A long, flat strip of light-colored wood with a smooth finish, forming the stationary lower arm of the tongs.
parts.function: Provides the rigid base against which the moving arm presses to grip objects.

parts.name: pivot pin

physics.Basic_description: A tiny silver metallic pin located at the center junction where the two wooden arms meet.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the hinge axis allowing the moving arm to rotate relative to the fixed arm.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and embedded to be grasped directly; the gripper should avoid applying force here.
physics.reason: Small fasteners like pins are typically solid metal rods to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: A tiny silver metallic pin located at the center junction where the two wooden arms meet.
parts.function: Acts as the hinge axis allowing the moving arm to rotate relative to the fixed arm.

parts.name: arm strip 1

physics.Basic_description: A long, flat strip of light-colored wood matching the fixed arm, forming the upper movable lever of the tongs.
physics.Functional_description: Pivots around the central pin to close against the fixed arm, creating the clamping force needed to hold items.
physics.Grasped_description: The primary actuation point; a gripper would press down on the handle end of this strip to operate the tongs.
physics.reason: Like the fixed arm, this is a solid wooden slat with no internal cavity.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
